ValidationRule.description: First name of contact mandatory. Excluded for admins and data team
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: isblank( FirstName ) && $Profile.Name <> 'Custom: Data Management' && $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' && $Profile.Name <> 'B2BMA Integration User' && $Profile.Name <> 'Custom: Fin/Ops/HR'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add First Name of the Contact
